gen.title: Building relative time before absolute dating
gen.orderNote: Follows the passage order from Steno to Powell

steps.label: Steno writes stratigraphic laws
steps.quote: Nicholas Steno, 1669, gets credit for first writing down basic geological principles as laws.

steps.label: Hutton proposes uniformitarianism
steps.quote: In 1788, James Hutton proposed what would become the foundational principle of geology — uniformitarianism.

steps.label: Smith defines faunal succession
steps.quote: In 1815, Smith developed the law of faunal succession, which states that species become extinct and are replaced by new species

steps.label: First geologic time scale published
steps.quote: The first geologic time scale was published in 1841 — Powell certainly would have known of it and used it in his geologic trips to the West.

steps.label: Powell sketches Great Unconformity
steps.quote: he was the first geologist to sketch the Great Unconformity in the Grand Canyon.
